en.title: Bone graft for a cleft in the upper jaw

implant: one way to fill the gap

sentences.text: This child was born with a cleft on the left side.
The pink gum covers a gap in the bone that holds the teeth.
Without the gum, you can see the gap.
A bone graft fills this gap with bone.
2 to 3 years later, bone joins the two parts of the jaw.
The eye tooth has come down through the new bone, and braces line up the teeth.
Years later, an implant, a bridge or a plate can fill the space where a tooth never grew.
Or braces move the eye tooth into the gap, and the dentist shapes it.
Your cleft team will help you choose.
